subject: your new sdr team
body:
Hi Sam,

Saw you are hiring a Senior SDR to build your first outbound team in Austin.

Most new SDR teams spend their first few months figuring out which accounts are really worth calling. We track the companies that are hiring for sales right now, so your reps can start every week with a short list of warm accounts. The first list is free, and we guarantee every account is real.

Would it help to see the list we would send your team this week?

Alex
evidence: We are building our first outbound SDR team in Austin.
